title: Special Relativity
description: The speed of light is the same for everyone - so time and space cannot be. Unlocks the Tensor Calculus Engine.

puzzle.goal: A body of rest mass m moves at speed v. Write its total energy as the rest-mass energy multiplied by the time-dilation factor, written out in full in terms of v and c.
puzzle.name: Relativistic energy (mass-energy equivalence)
puzzle.ask: Find the total energy of m = @{m} kg moving at 0.6c, with c in units of 1e8 m/s (so v = 1.8) - the answer is in 1e16 J.
puzzle.method: The energy is the time component of the four-momentum, γmc², with γ = 1/√(1 − v²/c²).
